title: Italian Beer Cheese Wrap
description: A savory Italian-inspired wrap filled with beer-steeped cheese and served warm. Perfect for a casual snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the beer and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let steep for 5 minutes, or until slightly reduced.
Add the cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Warm the Japanese wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Spoon the beer-steeped cheese onto the center of the wrap.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
